full_prompt_en: A bright child friendly anime illustration centers a girl with short black twin ponytails against a plain warm gray background. She faces the viewer directly, framed from the upper chest upward, with large clear blue eyes that carry small white reflections. Straight dark bangs fall across her forehead, while a white streak arcs through the hair on the right side of the image. A blue bow is tied near the left ponytail, and a few wispy strands fall beside the cheeks. Her face is softly rounded with pale skin, delicate rosy cheeks, and a tiny closed mouth, creating a quiet, curious expression. A vivid orange red hooded top lies open at the neck over a black shirt; two patterned turquoise straps run down from the shoulders and cross the lower edge of the square crop. The simple clothing shapes and limited accessories make the face and color contrasts immediately readable. Her hair has clean dark blocks broken by thin highlighted strands, while the top has a few loose folds and small painterly marks rather than dense detail. Gentle frontal light brightens the cheeks, eye reflections, and white hair streak, leaving a soft maroon shadow under the chin. The background has no objects and almost no texture, so every contour of the head and shoulders is clear. The whole image feels approachable and neatly designed, with lively blue and orange accents around a still central gaze.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅明亮、适合儿童观看的动漫插画在素净的暖灰背景前居中描绘一位留着黑色短双马尾的女孩。她正面看向观者，画面截取上胸以上；硕大清澈的蓝眼带着细小白色反光。整齐深色刘海落在额前，画面右侧的头发中弯过一道白色发缕。左侧马尾附近系着蓝色蝴蝶结，几缕细软散发垂在脸颊旁。脸部柔和圆润，皮肤浅色，双颊有淡红，嘴巴小巧闭合，形成安静好奇的神情。鲜明的橙红色连帽上衣在颈部敞开，内搭黑色衬衫；两条有花纹的青绿色背带从肩上垂下，穿过方形画面的下缘。简单的衣物形状和有限配件让脸与色彩对照一眼可读。头发由干净深色块与细薄高光发丝构成；上衣只有少量松散褶皱和绘画性小痕迹，没有密集细节。温和正面光照亮脸颊、眼中反光与白发缕，下巴下方留一块柔和栗红阴影。背景没有物件，几乎没有纹理，因此头和肩的每段轮廓都清楚。整幅画亲切且设计整洁，以活泼蓝橙点缀围住静止的中央凝视。
style_prompt_en: A bright accessible anime rendering with a centered front facing form, oversized clear focal marks, and a very simple warm neutral background. Build the main silhouette from clean dark masses and a few playful asymmetries, then add thin highlights and small colored accessories as visual accents. Use smooth pale planes with gentle cheek color, crisp outlines, and broad clothing folds rather than intricate texture. Pair one vivid warm garment color with a cool blue or turquoise accent so the design reads quickly at small size. Soft frontal illumination should brighten the focal details and leave only a shallow shadow beneath them. Keep the overall mood friendly, calm, and neatly organized, with clear separation between form and empty ground.
style_prompt_zh: 采用明亮易读的动漫渲染，让居中的正面形体、硕大清澈的焦点标记和极简暖中性背景相配。用干净深色色块和少量俏皮的不对称建立主要剪影，再加细薄高光与小型彩色配件作为视觉点缀。使用平滑浅色平面、柔和的面颊色、清晰轮廓及宽阔衣褶，减少繁复肌理。让一种鲜明暖色衣物与冷蓝或青绿色强调色相配，使设计在小尺寸下一眼可读。柔和正面光应照亮焦点细节，只在其下留浅浅阴影。整体气氛友好、平静且组织整洁，形体与空背景之间清楚分离。
theme_en: Blue eyed girl with twin ponytails
name: Kodomomuke anime style
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
